description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of exchange with effect from 25.09.2017 to 01.10.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the determination of new currency exchange rates for customs duties and charges by the Additional Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for import/export transactions, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it establishes statutory instruments for customs valuation and rescinds previous regulations.
